name: open-tgate
description: Inspect authorized Telegram history and audit, with optional scoped workspace knowledge, reviewed drafts and account labels.

interface.longDescription: Connect your authorized Open-TGate workspace using OAuth. Inspect synchronized accounts, messages, contacts, observed deletion/edit events and approved knowledge. Optional explicit grants manage knowledge, generate reviewed drafts and rename workspace account labels. Availability depends on deployed capabilities; Telegram sending and login credentials are not exposed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my connected Telegram accounts and recent audit events.
